verdict.rationale: Termius is a client app backed by cloud-synced vaults, so self-hosting its core (for example, its sync backend) is a fair question. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted deployment option. Local encrypted storage and direct connections without a proxy are an adjacent capability, not self-hosting, and vaults are described as end-to-end encrypted cloud storage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
